resources.name: DBnary
resources.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 for extracted lexical data; verify constituent Wiktionary terms per release
resources.potential: broad multilingual lexical forms and translation relations
resources.identityAssessment: does not provide a universal, independently adjudicated cross-language concept identity; lexical-sense links are evidence only
resources.decision: do not integrate as an exact identity provider; candidate-evidence adapter could be reconsidered with a pinned subset and license manifest

resources.name: Wikidata Lexemes
resources.license: Wikidata structured data is CC0; item/lexeme completeness and source provenance vary
resources.potential: stable lexical entity IDs, multilingual forms, lexical categories, and links to Q-items
resources.identityAssessment: lexeme IDs identify lexical records, not necessarily a shared language-independent sense; Q-item links require independently verified context
resources.decision: retain stable-entity provider for pinned named-entity evidence; do not promote label or lexeme matching to generic exact concept identity

conclusion: Neither audited resource currently falsifies the OMW/context bottleneck. External data may supply candidate evidence, but exact identity still requires a pinned, provider-owned or independently adjudicated stable grounding assertion.
